subject: lang-dy
title: LANG.DY.------RT.ALGN.
description: Chart on book p. 319 (R(AS)CM(I)-3). LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the partner. From the subject: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From MT-IF-DB: DIFF, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From T-C-IMP: RE-ST (restructuralism). From DIFF: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and PART (participation). From RE-ST: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis). From PROJ-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From PART: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics).
